REGIME: YELLOW2 red / 1 amber · Breakouts CAUTION — 2 red / 1 amber tells; be selective, trim size.
Trend ✓ (IXIC/SPX 10>21)
Are IXIC and SPX both above their rising 10>21-day MAs? Both up = green tape, both down = red. Setups fight the tide when this is red — 環境優先.
Breadth >50MA 62%
Percent of S&P 500 stocks above their own 50-day MA. >50% = broad participation; <40% = a narrow rally carried by few names — fragile.
>200MA 65%
Percent of S&P 500 stocks above their 200-day MA — the market's long-term health. Below 50% means most stocks are in downtrends even if the index looks fine.
Distribution 7d
O'Neil distribution days in the last ~20 sessions: the index fell >0.2% on HIGHER volume than the prior day = institutions selling into strength. 4-5 = caution, 6+ = danger.
Climax SPX +2% · P54
How stretched the leading index is above its 50-day MA, ranked against its ENTIRE history (P90 = more extended than 90% of all days). P90+ often precedes a blow-off / mean reversion.
Leaders <50DMA 2% · noNH 0%
Percent of the market's leading stocks that broke below their 50-day MA / stopped making new highs. Leaders roll over BEFORE the index does — this is the early-warning line.
Range: holding
Where the index sits inside its recent ~20-session range. Holding the upper half = healthy; sliding toward the floor = watch for a breakdown.
T2108 54% ▲1
Worden T2108: percent of NYSE stocks above their 40-day MA. <40% = weak internals. DIVERGE = the index makes highs while T2108 falls — a hard red flag.
Breakout win 46% (n50)
The win-rate of THIS scanner's own recent breakout signals. When fresh breakouts keep failing (<35%), the tape is hostile no matter how good the charts look — hard override.
Sectors: 3/4 leaders weak · 7/12 soft
How many of the leading sectors are losing relative strength vs SPX. Leadership rotating off (2+ leaders weak) is an early distribution signal.
VIX 16.07 (+3%) · calm <20 不計分
The options-market fear gauge. Calm (<20) is informational only; >20 or a +15% one-day spike = expect wider swings and failed follow-through.
Early-warning tells: leaders rolling over, topping breakdown, T2108 + divergence, breakout win-rate, sector RS. A perfect setup in a RED tape is a losing trade — 環境優先，型態其次.

📖 Post-HVE U&R Strategy (Like MXL Apr 28)
Setup: Day 2-5 after massive HVE breakout. Volume dries to <50% of Day 1 (institutional holding).
Trigger: Price undercuts Previous Day Low, flushes stops, then violently reclaims.
Entry: On reclaim of the undercut level with volume expansion.
Stop: 1% below the wick low of the undercut day (typically 2-4% risk).
Example: MXL Day 3 — vol dried from 29M to 5.6M (19%), undercut $50.40 to $49.60, reclaimed for 2.6% risk, then +30% next day!

📌 精簡摘要 — Martin 心法 (Trading Mindset) — tap to expand
  • 環境優先，型態其次 — 再完美的型態，遇到惡劣大盤都是輸的交易。(Environment > setup, always.)
  • 每筆交易獨立 — 可以更高價買回（$90停損→$91可進），但絕不追高（→$100不買）。
  • 緊停損 × 高頻再進場 — 接受常被洗出；邊際在於再進場與找下一檔強勢股，不是放寬停損。
  • 不怕錯過 — 被洗後續漲是好訊號（環境健康），去找下一檔即可。
  • 開盤別急（前15–30分鐘）— 多數虧損是跌破開盤低點後反轉；等「跌破ORL→收回」再進，勝率更高。
  • 槓桿是緊停損的副產品 — 0.4%停損的300%槓桿 = 1%風險。複製『風險』，不要複製『槓桿』。
  • 避開乖離過大的延伸股 — 9/21/50 EMA一旦大幅張開、價格遠離9EMA，就出局等下一個底部。
  • 賣在強勢、停損在弱勢 — 沿9/21 EMA移動停損；過度延伸（離9EMA約15–20%）一律分批了結。
  • 調整到適合自己 — 時間框架、停損幅度、單筆風險、周轉率，微調到符合自己的心理與作息。
